description: This file defines the `SupervisorUserRole` class, which extends `AbstractUserRole`. It manages access permissions for a supervisor within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to retrieve accessible employee IDs, location IDs, and performance review IDs based on the supervisor's role, as well as quick launch features.

classes.name: SupervisorUserRole
classes.description: Class responsible for handling supervisor user role permissions, including access to employees, locations, reviews, and quick launch features.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LocationService.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Returns a list of IDs accessible for a given entity type, such as Employee, Location, or PerformanceReview.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeIds
methods.description: Retrieves the list of subordinate employee IDs supervised by the current user.

methods.name: getAccessibleLocationIds
methods.description: Retrieves location IDs for employees accessible to the supervisor.

methods.name: getAccessibleReviewIds
methods.description: Retrieves performance review IDs for the supervisor.

methods.name: getAccessibleQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Fetches the quick launch list accessible to the supervisor.
